import openpyxl, os
from openpyxl.styles import PatternFill, Border, Side

in_path = os.environ['IN_XLSX']
out_path = os.environ['OUT_XLSX']

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(in_path)
test_ws = wb['Test']
master_ws = wb['master']

# Collect yellow cells from column A of Test sheet
yellow_values = []
for r in range(1, test_ws.max_row + 1):
    cell = test_ws.cell(row=r, column=1)
    fill = cell.fill
    if fill.patternType == 'solid':
        fg = fill.fgColor
        try:
            rgb = fg.rgb
            if rgb == 'FFFFFF00':
                if cell.value is not None and str(cell.value).strip() != '':
                    yellow_values.append(cell.value)
        except Exception:
            pass

print('Yellow non-blank values:', len(yellow_values))
for i, v in enumerate(yellow_values):
    print(f'  {i+1}: {repr(v)}')

# Clear existing row 1 in master (up to AH = col 34)
for c in range(1, 35):
    cell = master_ws.cell(row=1, column=c)
    cell.value = None
    cell.fill = PatternFill(fill_type=None)
    cell.border = Border()

# Write yellow values into row 1 of master
yellow_fill = PatternFill(start_color='FFFF00', end_color='FFFF00', fill_type='solid')
thin_border = Border(
    left=Side(style='thin'),
    right=Side(style='thin'),
    top=Side(style='thin'),
    bottom=Side(style='thin')
)

for i, val in enumerate(yellow_values):
    col = i + 1
    cell = master_ws.cell(row=1, column=col)
    cell.value = val
    cell.fill = yellow_fill
    cell.border = thin_border

print(f'Wrote {len(yellow_values)} cells to master row 1')

wb.save(out_path)
print('Saved.')
